items.summary: Disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional only for bounded reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Woot rights are not established, security/accuracy/measurement gates remain blocked, and human counsel is required before rights-dependent launch or monetization decisions. Ordinary growth is not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry.

Tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms evidence is insufficient to close any task. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not send outreach or close tasks without direct evidence.

Keep scaffold properties parked, private, and preview-only. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue entries. Continue dated readiness packets covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundaries, rollback, and explicit blockers.

Keep public exposure and security-sensitive releases blocked while access, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, TLS, data-exposure, monitoring, incident, and disclosure evidence remains unavailable. Continue bounded read-only evidence work only; do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions, deploy, add dependencies, or conduct outreach.
